title: {opp}'s assistant has had a crack
text: One of their assistants has told the press your side "won't handle the heat" this week.

choices.label: Fire back
choices.result: You fire back. It's on for Saturday.

title: Someone from {opp} was spotted at your training
text: One of their analysts, in a hoodie, by the fence.

choices.label: Close training this week
choices.result: The gates are shut. The members are annoyed.

choices.label: Let them watch
choices.result: Let them watch. The players find it funny.

title: {opp}'s players have been mouthing off
text: It's all over social media. The group has seen it.

choices.label: Pin it to the noticeboard
choices.result: It's on the noticeboard. Training is fierce.

choices.label: Keep the group calm
choices.result: You tell the group to ignore it.
